content_sections.heading: About District Child Protection Unit, Coimbatore
content_sections.text: The District Child Protection Unit, Coimbatore runs under the Mission Vatsalya scheme of the Department of Children Welfare and Special Services. Child Helpline 1098 is part of this unit and gives a 24-hour service in shifts. The District Collector, Coimbatore issued this recruitment as a press release.

content_sections.heading: Coimbatore District Child Protection Unit Supervisor Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit shall not exceed 42 years. Mandatory: Graduate from a recognized university. Preferred: B.A in Social Work / Computer Science / Information Technology / Community Sociology / Social Sciences. Computer skills: Proficiency in Computers. Experienced candidates get weightage. Preference may be given to people who have worked in emergency helplines. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The post will be filled through a direct interview of candidates who meet the qualifications above.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on a contract basis. The place of posting is the Gandhipuram Child Help Desk of Child Helpline 1098, which runs 24 hours a day in shifts.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Coimbatore District Child Protection Unit Supervisor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the Coimbatore District administration website and download the application form. Fill in the form completely. Attach self-attested copies of all your educational and experience certificates. Send the form to the address below so that it reaches the office by 05.45 PM on 15 November 2026. Address: District Child Protection Officer, District Child Protection Unit, District Collectorate, Coimbatore District – 641 018. Completed application form Self-attested copies of all educational certificates Self-attested copies of all experience certificates

faq.question: Q1. Which post is being filled?
faq.answer: One Supervisor post at the Gandhipuram Child Help Desk of Child Helpline 1098, which is part of the District Child Protection Unit, Coimbatore.

faq.question: Q2. What is the pay for the Supervisor post?
faq.answer: The notice prints a pay of Rs. 21,000/- for the post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age?
faq.answer: Your age must not be more than 42 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is a degree in Social Work compulsory?
faq.answer: No. Any graduate from a recognized university can apply. A B.A in Social Work, Computer Science, Information Technology, Community Sociology or Social Sciences is preferred.

faq.question: Q5. Does experience help?
faq.answer: Yes. Experienced candidates get weightage, and preference may be given to people who have worked in emergency helplines.

faq.question: Q6. Where do I get the application form?
faq.answer: You download it from the Coimbatore District administration website, https://coimbatore.nic.in/.

faq.question: Q7. Where should I send the application?
faq.answer: Send it to the District Child Protection Officer, District Child Protection Unit, District Collectorate, Coimbatore District – 641 018, with self-attested copies of your educational and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the deadline?
faq.answer: Your application must reach the office by 05.45 PM on 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q9. How will the candidate be selected?
faq.answer: Through a direct interview. The appointment will be on a contract basis.
